title: The extra present-time weight
hook: Two stated cases: explore the separate roles of present bias and ordinary discounting.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the separate roles of present bias and ordinary discounting affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Advantage, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the separate roles of present bias and ordinary discounting in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy model values immediate 100 normally, but delayed 120 after 2 periods as Beta 0.7 times Delta 0.95 to the delay. What is delayed minus immediate value?

claims.text: An extra present-time weight can reverse the ranking when an option becomes immediate. The weights are explicit model assumptions. This comparison isolates the separate roles of present bias and ordinary discounting.
